newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Seven die in bus crash in former Soviet Georgia.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in bus crash in former Soviet Georgia.

text.p: At least seven people were killed and 20 were injured in Georgia when a bus plunged 60 metres (180 feet) from a cliff and crashed into a mountain river, the Interior Ministry said on Monday.
The accident happened on Sunday in a remote region 200 km (125 miles) northwest of the capital Tbilisi.

Rescue workers expected up to 10 more bodies to be retrieved from the wreckage, a ministry spokesman said. Investigators were examining the possibility that the driver might have suffered a heart attack.
